INT.ref_text: So tell me a little about your mornings. What does a normal day look like for you, before a big game? Take your time, there's no rush at all.

NINE.ref_text: Most mornings I wake up before everyone else. The house is quiet. I make the coffee, I sit by the window, and I think about the day ahead.

CHILD.ref_text: I already brushed my teeth and I found my shoes. Can we go now? You said we would go early today. I remember.

PARTNER.ref_text: It's fine. It's good, actually. I just think it could use a little something. We can talk about it later, okay?

ELDER.ref_text: I have been coming to this bakery for forty years. Every morning, the same bread, the same table. And I watch every match.

RADIO.ref_text: Good morning and welcome back. The traffic is heavy on the ring road, and later we'll look ahead to the big match on Friday.

NINE_VO.who: TR-PLAYER-09 — diary voice-over (inner voice, never on camera)
NINE_VO.ref_text: Most mornings I wake up before everyone else. The house is quiet. I make the coffee, I sit by the window, and I think about the day ahead.

lines.speaker: RADIO
lines.text: Belgium against Türkiye, this Friday. And the whole country is asking one question

lines.speaker: INT
lines.text: You don't listen to that stuff?

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: My mother sends me all of it anyway.

lines.speaker: INT
lines.text: Everyone wants to know what's going to happen Friday.

lines.speaker: INT
lines.text: What does playing for Türkiye mean to you?

lines.speaker: NINE
lines.text: You feel like everyone's coming with you.

lines.speaker: NINE_VO
lines.text: I've been awake since four. Don't tell him.

lines.speaker: NINE_VO
lines.text: My father made eggs before every game I ever played. He's not here to make them anymore. So I do.

lines.speaker: NINE_VO
lines.text: She has never let me finish one.

lines.speaker: NINE_VO
lines.text: He asked my father for two goals, thirty years ago. He got one.

lines.speaker: NINE_VO
lines.text: This is the only place it goes quiet.

lines.speaker: NINE_VO
lines.text: He's the only defender I'm afraid of.

lines.speaker: NINE_VO
lines.text: She told me at six forty-six.
lines.say: She told me at six forty six.

lines.speaker: NINE_VO
lines.text: At his age I slept in my father's shirt too.
